evidence.source: FINDINGS §40.5 (VACASK 0.3.4.rc1 secondary crash; empty stdout, zero-length hb1.raw. It reads like a Windows file-locking problem and is not one -- it is spectrum construction, and clears at nharm 3, 6, 7, 8)

rule: Prove a second simulator's port on DC and S21 against a live run of the first before reading any design number from it, and never trust a model-card version string.

applicability.applies: Any migration to a second engine or a new PDK. Load-bearing details to re-check explicitly: rshunt equivalence (ngspice's .option rshunt=1e12 becomes 1 Tohm to ground on every node; six gates in this design have no other DC path) and the S-parameter port convention.
applicability.not: A faithful port does not make the two engines interchangeable: an engine can abort on specific (f0, tone spacing, nharm) combinations and destroy its own error message on the way out. Walk a ladder and record which setting each row used, backed by a fence proving the setting does not move the answer.
